title: Endpoint update
description: abs apply --force where the existing bot is bound to the supplied app id but has a different messaging endpoint. The plan is an in-place idempotent ARM update, so apply performs exactly one arm.upsert and reports status updated. Exit 0.

changes.detail: Existing bot will be updated in place (idempotent ARM upsert): endpoint https://old-gateway.contoso.com/api/messages → https://gateway.contoso.com/api/messages.
Operator supplied an explicit app id (msaAppId); zero-Graph — no Entra application or service principal is created or modified.
Operator supplied an explicit app id (msaAppId); zero-Graph — no Entra application or service principal is created or modified.

preflight.detail: The Microsoft.BotService resource provider is registered on the subscription.
Subscription sub-contoso exists and is readable by the operator.
Resource group rg-agenthost exists and is readable by the operator.
Existing bot resolved by resource id; it will be updated in place, not duplicated.
Operator supplied an explicit app id; Entra app correlation is not used.
ARM read calls succeeded, proving the provisioning audience is reachable with the operator token. The supplied-app path requires no Microsoft Graph call.
ARM write capability cannot be confirmed without a mutating probe; it is validated at apply time and surfaces as a permission error if missing.
No non-mutating quota check exists for SKU F0; if capacity is denied at apply, retry with S1.
Azure Policy denials have no read-only simulation for a single PUT; they surface as a governance error at apply.

nextActions: The bot was updated; the connection now matches the desired state.
